utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we decide on a date for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, but I heard it’s being sorted out soon. I’ll check in and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — please do, and let me know as soon as you hear a date.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over whatever tools you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — that’d be a huge help. I might need a minute to remember exactly what’s missing, though.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush at all, Noah — just let me know when you remember, and I’ll swing by with whatever I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is moving along nicely — folks are still dropping off supplies. I can tell you what I’ve heard so far if you want.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help, thanks — I’m just trying to figure out where the supplies are going and whether there’s enough room.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They’re being sorted at the community hall for now, and I heard there’s still a bit of room left. If you want, I can tell you what kinds of supplies they’re asking for most.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you check the repair supplies by the garage and let me know what’s missing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the supplies by the garage and let you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive and invite a few neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Quinn. That means a lot to me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll start with the folks on Maple and swing by the corner houses too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, thanks for helping out with the repair drive—I'm getting the list organized now. If you’ve got any supplies or contacts to add, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can add a few tool contacts and some extra tape, screws, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Leo — I’ll add those to the list right away. Thanks, that’ll help us a lot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m a bit late to the details myself, but I can help you check what’s been set up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. Let’s go through what’s been set up so I can double-check the details before I act.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what time are the school drop-offs and pickups so we can plan around them?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — drop-offs are around 8:15 and pickups around 3:00, so we can plan the repair drive around those windows.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, that helps a lot. I can volunteer between those windows, so just let me know what still needs to be covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I just heard about the repair drive second-hand, so I’m a bit behind — what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly just volunteers and a few tools—if you can spread the word, that’d help a lot. I’m happy to fill you in on the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can spread the word around the block, and I’d love the quick rundown on what tools you still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just point me to the main repairs and I’ll skim the rest later.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’ll check the main repairs first, and then skim the rest later?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll check the main repairs first and skim the rest later.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, thanks, Rey. I could really use help sorting donations and carrying a few boxes; I keep misplacing the labels.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort the donations and carry boxes for you. Point me to the labels, and I’ll keep them together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll pass the repair drive plan along and make sure everyone knows the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supply list and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word and check back in once I’ve talked to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going steadily so far, nothing dramatic yet. I’m still hearing back from folks one by one.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Glad to hear it’s moving along. If you hear any big updates, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I should remember that. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Could you bring a few tools and some gloves? I’ll remind everyone else too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll grab a few tools and some gloves. Thanks for the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest update, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah—could you help sort donations this Saturday morning? Just let me know if that works.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday morning should work for me—just point me to the donations and I’ll sort them out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a tool or two for the repair drive. What do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. The main thing I need is a clear list of what’s still missing, then I can make a simple plan and stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll help you make a clean missing-items list so you can tackle it one step at a time. Tell me what you’ve already got, and I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing, Mara — could you help spread the word and sign people up for a few time slots? I’m happy to send you the details right now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — send me the details and I’ll start sharing it around and signing folks up for time slots.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—want me to reach out to a few folks?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be wonderful, Jules — could you let people know it’s at the community center on Maple, Saturday from 10 to 2?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll let folks know it’s at the community center on Maple this Saturday from 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving. I can organize the list and help match folks with what they need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I can check our supplies and note what we’re short on. Let’s make sure we have the basics covered before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll draft the needs list and keep it updated, and you can flag any gaps in the supplies. Once we know what’s missing, I’ll help line up volunteers to fill them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting started soon—I've been hearing bits and pieces from around the block. If you know what they still need, I’m happy to pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. Do they still need tools, or are they mostly looking for volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure yet, but I can check what I’ve heard and spread the word. If you learn they need something specific, let me know and I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring or do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you bring a few boxes of packing tape and help label the donation bins? I’m also trying to line up someone to set up before school starts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can bring the tape and help label the bins. I’m not sure about the before-school setup, but I can ask around.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re really willing to help with the repair drive? If so, I can tell you what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, absolutely — I’m willing to help. Tell me what needs doing, and I’ll take care of it.
